Composition.description: What a customer assembled in library mode (BRIEF Section 16): the order record and the only input to a library export. Contract 2 (Section 17): Kiosk to fulfilment, and the seed of a bespoke job. Geometry is the species base mesh plus the family delta plus one region delta per region, plus shell parts on sockets; colour is the base colour, then pattern layers in order (signed-distance masks thresholded at their coverage), then stamps, then eyes and nose.

base_mesh_version.description: Must equal the release's base mesh version.

breed_id.description: The breed the customer started from (informational).

layers.description: Pattern layers, composited in this order over the base colour.

coverage.description: The mask threshold: the layer covers texels whose mask value is below coverage.

parts.description: One region-delta part id per region; a region left out keeps the family's shape.

release_version.description: The library release the ids refer to.

stamps.description: Spots, patches and brush dabs, painted after the layers in this order. Positions are in base-mesh space (mm), so a stamp stays put when parts change and lands correctly across UV seams. Symmetry writes the mirrored stamp explicitly.

Composition.title: Composition

ReleaseManifest.description: manifest.json of a library release bundle, release-<species>-<n>.tar (BRIEF Section 17, contract 1: Studio to Kiosk). The tar holds manifest.json, manifest.sig (HMAC-SHA256 of manifest.json with the release key) and every file listed, each checked by sha256 on load. Drafts and rejected parts never appear here.

channels.description: Mask name -> flat channel index (file index * 4 + channel); includes eye and nose.

mask_files.description: RGBA PNGs in the species UV atlas; each channel is one mask.

base_topology.description: topology_hash of the base mesh every delta was extracted on; a kiosk refuses a release whose hash differs from its own base mesh.

delta.description: float16 (n, 3) full-mesh vertex offsets, little endian.

mesh.description: Path of base.bin: the base mesh the client builds its preview from (positions, triangles, corner UVs, eye and nose masks per vertex).

delta.description: float16 (n, 3) vertex offsets, zero outside the region and feathered by the region's vertex-group weights.

kind.description: The accessory-library mesh (collar, bandana, bow, hat, glasses) the export fuses.

mesh.description: GLB of the shell in its socket frame (unit scale, Z up).

get.description: WebSocket. Each text frame is a ProgressEvent JSON; the server closes after the job reaches done, failed or fulfilled. Browsers cannot send headers on a WebSocket, so the staff token goes in the `token` query parameter. Close code 4401 means no valid token, 4404 unknown job.
